title: fix(service-datasource): testing a datasource draft no longer creates its SQLite database file

_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuPMZ8BHWtPf6nBTp51qSM64)_

Fixes #27512

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — Metadata-protocol is none and there is no narrowing arm; nothing an author writes changes.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：数据源草稿的「测试连接」（`POST /api/v1/datasources/test`）遇到不存在的 SQLite 文件时，改为回报「文件不存在」，不再在磁盘上创建这个文件和它缺失的目录。
- **为什么改**：测试连接什么都不保存，却会按「启动写库」的方式打开 SQLite，管理员输错路径就会在服务器上留下空数据库文件（sqlite、sqlite-wasm、turso `file:` 三种驱动实测都会建）。
- **风险与回滚**：只改草稿探测这一条路，判断在探测内部、建驱动之前；导出类型与默认工厂与 main 字节一致，保存数据源、启动恢复、热注册连接池仍照旧建文件。回滚即还原 `datasource-admin-plugin.ts`。
- **先看**：`datasource-admin-plugin.ts` 的 `probe`（调工厂前的 `absentDatabaseFileRefusal` 一行）及文件尾部的 `probedDatabaseFile` / `absentDatabaseFileRefusal`。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-datasource exec vitest run src/__tests__/draft-probe-creates-no-database-file.test.ts`，预期 15/15 通过。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `DatasourceAdminServicePlugin.probe` (the draft probe behind `POST /api/v1/datasources/test`) judges a file-backed draft before it asks the driver factory for anything: `sqlite` / `sqlite3` and `sqlite-wasm` (`config.filename`, absent ⇒ `:memory:`), and `turso` / `libsql` with a `file:` url (scheme in any letter case, path as driver-turso's local engine opens it). A draft whose file does not exist is answered on the probe's existing verdict door, HTTP `200` with `result.ok: false` and an error naming the file (`SQLite database file 'PATH' does not exist. Testing a connection never creates it: …`); a path that can be neither opened nor created gets driver-sql's own `SqliteDatabaseFileError` text. Nothing is written to find out.
- The existence judgement is driver-sql's one write-free check, `resolveSqliteAbsentFileTarget` (an absent file reads `openedEmptyInMemory`; an unopenable one throws), so no second `existsSync` is open-coded.
- Internal only: the two helpers are module-private in `datasource-admin-plugin.ts`. `contracts/datasource-driver-factory.ts`, `default-datasource-driver-factory.ts` and every export are byte-identical to `main`. Because the check is the probe's own, it holds whichever driver factory the host registers.
- Unchanged: Save, the boot restore, hot pools and `DatasourceConnectionService` build through the factory exactly as before and still create the file; `:memory:` and server databases are never judged; the Setup page already renders `result.error`.

## Tests

New `src/__tests__/draft-probe-creates-no-database-file.test.ts`, through the real door (real `HonoHttpServer`, real admin routes, real plugin probe, default driver factory unless the case says otherwise):

- 10 cases: each of `sqlite`, `sqlite3`, `sqlite-wasm`, `turso`, `libsql` × a missing flat path and a missing nested path → `200`, `success: true`, `result.ok: false`, error names the file, the file does not exist and the temp root is still empty (no directory made).
- A host factory (a fake whose `create` is a spy) is never asked to build any of the five drafts on a missing path; all answer `ok: false`; nothing created.
- A path under a regular file (can be neither opened nor created) → `ok: false` naming the file; only the blocker file remains.
- Controls: an existing SQLite file still probes `ok: true` and nothing else appears beside it; a `:memory:` draft probes `ok: true`; the default factory, used directly as Save uses it, still creates the file on connect.

## Acceptance notes

- **PM assumption measured.** Before the fix, a probe on a missing path created the file AND its missing directories for `sqlite`, `sqlite-wasm` and `turso` (`file:` url); measured through `DatasourceAdminServicePlugin.probe` with the default factory on the built tree (all three answered `ok: true` and left `nested/dir/X.db` behind). `memory` with file persistence creates nothing on a probe (measured), so it is not judged.
- **The existing `sqliteAbsentFile: 'empty-in-memory'` option was not used**, as the order said: it is factory-wide and answers `ok` on a missing file.
- **Shape changed in review (seat REWORK on `d9b68b90`).** The first shape carried a `fileMustExist` intent on `DatasourceConnectionSpec`, an exported type, which widened the published surface (Clause-② would have been yes). The judgement now lives inside the probe; the contract and the default factory are back to `main`'s bytes, so `Clause-②: no` holds.
- **"code + status" read as the probe's verdict door.** The draft probe answers every failure as `200 { result: { ok: false, error } }`; `TestConnectionResult` has no `code` field, and adding one is a response-shape addition this card did not ask for, so it was not made. The door pin asserts status `200`, `ok: false`, the named file and the untouched filesystem; the kind is carried by the error's text, as for every other probe failure.
- **Read-only open not added.** Triage said "read-only and must-exist". Must-exist is what stops the file being created. For an EXISTING file, `SqlDriver.connect()` already writes nothing to a file whose pragmas are set (#21734); a read-only open would instead fail the probe on a legacy `auto_vacuum=NONE` file, whose connect issues the setter (read from the code, not measured). Left as is.
- **Embedded replica.** A `turso` draft whose local replica is a `file:` url that does not exist yet is now refused by the probe too (a first connect would have created the replica file). Consistent with the card: the probe creates nothing.
- The door pin asserts the error names the file and contains `does not exist`: the card's acceptance is literally that the probe reports the file does not exist, and the door carries no code, so that phrase is the one kind-bearing fact the Setup page shows.
- Branch is the card thread's harness-pinned `claude/project-thread-yhiysu` (the claim names it).
